title: pretty SAGE|Plus Size Ruched Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Why you'll love it?

  • Flutter sleeves give soft arm coverage without feeling tight, plus they move beautifully in photos.
  • Waist-defining pleats create shape while staying comfortable through the midsection (great for long ceremonies and receptions).
  • High-low maxi skirt feels airy and easy to walk in?ano heavy fabric dragging, and the draped front panel adds a flattering, flowy finish.

Best for?

  • Bridesmaids & bridal parties
  • Wedding guest looks (garden, beach, semi-formal)
  • Mother of the Bride / Groom
  • Engagement parties, bridal showers & rehearsal dinners
  • Formal dinners, galas & evening events


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
